baseline_tools.name: get_issue
baseline_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: List issues, filtered by status and/or assignee. Use to browse or enumerate issues; use search_issues to find issues by text in title or body, and get_issue for one known ID. Returns at most limit issues (default 50). Comments are included by default, so set include_comments to false for smaller responses.

include_comments.description: Whether to include each issue's comments. Defaults to true; set false for smaller, summary-only responses.

status.description: Filter by issue status. One of: open, in_progress, blocked, closed. Other values return an error. Omit for all statuses.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Search issues by case-insensitive text match on title or body. Use when you have keywords; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue for one known ID. No limit or status/assignee filters. Comments are included by default, so set include_comments to false for smaller responses.
